text:
Everything you think about success is backwards.

You chase the goal. Wrong. The goal chases you when your brain is magnetized.

Magnetized means obsessed. Daily thoughts. Your nervous system rewires. You catch opportunities others miss.

A man visualizes wealth for five years. One day he meets the exact person, the exact partnership he'd been magnetizing toward.

He didn't chase it. His magnetized brain attracted it.

Most men magnetize toward the phone, the excuse, the story.

Pick what magnetizes you today. Start now.
caption:
Success doesn't chase you. You have to be magnetized to attract it.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
